subject: Go-live bridge cadence & delegation plan
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@starlift.io>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Go-live bridge cadence & delegation plan

Hi Naomi / Marissa —

Thanks again for the runtime deep-dive last week. Our launch team reviewed the checklist and there are a few open items around operational handoffs and owner coverage during the bridge period (go-live + first 2 weeks). We sketched a short mutual action plan but wanted Redwood's confirmation on owners and timing before we circulate to our stakeholders.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirmation of primary owner for incident triage during M+0 to M+14 (who will be paged)
- SLA addendum sign-off timeline (we can accept a 10-business-day review if you can provide the draft)
- Clear step for Post-Go-Live Q/A and rollback criteria (who owns the decision)

Attaching our working MAP. Can you propose a lightly prescriptive cadence for 14 days post-go-live (daily stand -> every-other-day -> weekly) and assign Redwood owners?

Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones, owners, risk register)

— Alex Mercer
Director, Platform Integrations
Orion Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Go-live bridge cadence & delegation plan

Thanks Alex — this is helpful. I reviewed MAP_v2 and annotated owners inline. High-level proposal below; details are in the attached updated sheet (MAP_v2_redwood_notes).

Proposed bridge cadence (prescriptive):
- Day 0 (go-live): 2-hour post-deploy sync (all core owners)
- Days 1–3: daily 30-min stand to triage production feedback (CS + SRE + integration PM)
- Days 4–7: alternate-day 30-min check-ins, expand to app owners if needed
- Days 8–14: twice-weekly status until stability thresholds met

Primary owners:
- Incident triage (M+0 to M+14): Ben Carter (SRE lead) — will be primary pager, Karthik as escalation for infra falls-through
- Customer success / adoption queries: Marissa Cole — owns orchestration with Orion PMs
- SLA addendum: Naomi Feldman to shepherd internal review; we aim to surface final draft within 5 business days
- Rollback / go/no-go: Decision owner is joint (Redwood SRE + Orion Prod lead) with explicit rollback criteria in the MAP

I attached the updated MAP and an SLA addendum draft (SLA_addendum_draft.pdf). Please review the owners and proposed cadence; if Orion agrees we'll convert the MAP to a short DocuSign and lock dates.

Attachments: MAP_v2_redwood_notes.xlsx; SLA_addendum_draft.pdf

Thanks — I put a tentative sign-off milestone for 2027-04-19 so we can run the DocuSign process before your planned 04/25 go-live.

— Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Go-live bridge cadence & delegation plan

Adding operational constraints from the SRE side:
- Ben (primary pager) will be on-call M+0 through M+7 (24/7 rotation) with Karthik as weekday daytime escalation; after M+7, we move to a business-hours rotation unless a sustained incident is open.
- We need a firm list of endpoints Orion considers critical (I flagged 3 in the MAP). If Orion can confirm by EOD 4/15 we can tune alert thresholds to reduce noise.

Quick note: I'll be OOO 04/17–04/18 for a team retreat; Karthik will cover those dates for the pager.

— Ben Carter
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Go-live bridge cadence & delegation plan

Alex — looping in a slightly expanded milestone table and proposed owner contact matrix (phone / alternate email) below so the Orion ops team can reach the right person quickly. Please confirm the critical endpoints list Ben mentioned.

Milestone highlights (proposed dates):
- 2027-04-25: Go-live (target window 02:00–05:00 UTC)
- 2027-04-25 11:00 UTC: 2-hour post-deploy sync (Redwood + Orion core owners)
- 2027-04-26 to 2027-04-28: Daily 30-min triage (M+1–M+3)
- 2027-04-29 to 2027-05-02: Alternate-day check-ins (M+4–M+7)
- 2027-05-03 to 2027-05-09: Twice-weekly status (M+8–M+14)

Owner contact matrix (primary / backup):
- Incident triage: Ben Carter / Karthik Iyer
- CS adoption & tickets: Marissa Cole / Naomi Feldman
- Integration PM: Orion — Alex Mercer / Lina Gomez

Open questions:
1) Can Orion sign the SLA addendum by 2027-04-19? That allows legal to run DocuSign 4/20 and keeps us on schedule.
2) Which three endpoints should we prioritize for stricter alerting? (List ideally by 4/15 for SRE tuning)

If we get answers to those two items today we can lock the DocuSign envelope and calendar invites.

Next steps from Orion:

- We approve the proposed cadence and Ben's on-call window; noted Karthik covers 4/17–4/18.

Can Redwood confirm the calendar invites for the M+0 and M+1 triage stand? If you create them I will accept and unblock scheduling on our side.
